data.name: Sunset Jazz Cruise On Northern Lights
data.headline: Up to $72.08 | 2 hour Sail
data.description:
Come with friends or come aboard for 'date night' and enjoy the sound of live music! Unwind and forget about Monday for a little while longer as we venture out for a sunset cruise around Boston Harbor with our live jazz band! You'll hear a blend of vibrant modern grooves and select jazz standards as we cruise by Boston's epic skyline at sunset!

##About Northern Lights  
A Coast Guard Certified Captains and extremely friendly and knowledgeable crew who are trained to help in the event of an emergency operate Northern Lights. The motor yacht Northern Lights is stylized after the classic New England 1920s style steamships. She is one of the most comfortable and versatile cruise vessels in Boston Harbor. Northern Lights is 115-feet in length, features six bathrooms, and provides ample seating throughout the ship for up to 149 passengers. She is built for taking groups of people on spectacular sightseeing adventures. Thus, she is excellent for taking out groups of friends and family to see the harbor. Sit back and relax in our climate-controlled (heating and air conditioning) cabin or enjoy the sea breeze on our open top deck. Be sure to visit our fully stocked bar on the main deck to purchase refreshments.
data.highlights:
**Key Points about this Cruise:**
* Spectacular views of the Boston Skyline at sunset!
* Full Bar and appetizers available for purchase on board.
* Cruise by the Mystic Tobin Bridge, the Leonard Zakim Bridge,  the Custom House Tower, and Old North Church steeple.
* Pass Historic U.S. sites such as Fort Independence located on Castle Island, the USS Constitution and Bunker Hill Monument

data.cancellation_notes:
**Refund/Rescheduling Policy**
An option to reschedule or convert to a gift certificate is available up until 24 hours prior to departure. We are not able to offer refunds for bookings without Trip Cancellation Protection.  Requests for cancellation, rescheduling or conversion to gift credit must be sent by email to publicsails@boston-sailing.com.  

Most activities run regardless of weather conditions. In the rare situation where the seller is forced to cancel the event, ticket-holders will be allowed to reschedule to another time (subject to availability), receive credit for a future event, or receive a refund.

**Weather Policy**
Activity may be canceled due to severe weather.
The activity usually runs in light rain and other moderate weather conditions, but the seller may cancel the activity up to an hour before the start time in the event of severe or unsafe weather conditions. If the seller cancels the event, ticket-holders will be allowed to reschedule tickets (subject to availability), receive credit for a future event, or receive a refund.

**Other Policies**
All participants are required to have tickets for this event.
According to U.S. Coast Guard capacity rules, all passengers including infants and toddlers must have a ticket.

**Parties of 12 or more will be contacted for an additional gratuity charge of 15%**
Classic Harbor Line will contact you directly within 48 hours of your purchase to take your credit card information for the additional charge. You must be reachable at the telephone number and email you provided
data.booking_notes:
#Important Check-In Information:
This is not your ticket; this is just confirmation of a place for you aboard. Upon arrival, on the date of your event, you must go to our ticket counter to check-in (located in the ferry terminal at 60 Rowes Wharf) to get your boarding passes and obtain your pre-purchased items such as hats or wine vouchers.  Additionally, Please be sure to bring valid identification with you at check-in for purchase verification. 

___
**What to Wear**
Wear comfortable, weather appropriate, clothing. Light layers are recommended in the summer time and warmer layers in the spring and fall. We advise wearing flat shoes, as these are best for walking around the boat. 
__________
**What to Bring**
Comfortable weather appropriate clothing such as: sunscreen and sunglasses on warm sunny days and jackets and hats for cooler weather days.

We are Credit Card only aboard all of our boats. If you would like to purchase drinks or small snacks aboard the ship during your cruise, please remember to bring your credit card. 
_________
**What Not to Bring**

Please do not bring your own alcohol-you will be able to purchase beer, wine, and/or champagne while aboard.
_________ 
# Other Tips & Guidelines
Check in 15-30 minutes early at our (shared) booth. We board the boat promptly 15 minutes prior to departure. The vessel leaves on time and cannot come back to pick you up if you are late. No refunds or reschedules will be provided for late arrivals. 

If you have any food allergies/dietary needs please contact us before your trip (especially on any food related trips such as: Brunch or Luncheon. Please note that not all food allergies and dietary requests can be accommodated. 
________
**Important** Any directions or maps provided by Classic Harbor Line	are only a rough guide. You are responsible for arriving at the activity's meeting location on time, so make sure to check with a second source that can provide specific directions from your starting point.

**Detailed Directions** 
Our boats depart from Rowes Wharf, directly behind the Boston Harbor Hotel, located at (for GPS) 400 Atlantic Avenue, Boston (02110). Check-in at Rowes Wharf is located in the Ferry Terminal, a climate controlled public space, located on the wharf only steps away from our dock.  If you are lost or running late, please call us at 617-951-2460. 

Click [here](https://boston-sailing.com/locations-directions/) to view more detailed directions.

**Public Transport** 
Nearest "T" transit stations are South Station (Red, Purple, and Silver Lines) and Aquarium Station (Blue Line). 
![Map of Rowes Wharf](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/DbR8OL3gR3WhOcRJLw9w)
**Driving** 
*From the South:*

* Take Rt. I-93 north to the exit for South Station.
* Follow signs to South Station/Downtown.
* Turn right at the end of ramp onto Kneeland Street and turn at the second left onto Atlantic Avenue.
* Continue on Atlantic Avenue for 5 short blocks and the Boston Harbor Hotel and big arch will be on your right.
* A few feet from the big arch is the hotel parking entrance.

*From the West:*

* Follow the Mass. Pike/Rt. I-90 E to the exit for South Station.  This will put you on Atlantic Avenue.
* Continue on Atlantic Avenue for 5 short blocks.
* The Boston Harbor Hotel and big arch will be on your right.
* A few feet from the big arch is the hotel parking entrance.

*From the North:*

* Follow I-93 south to the exit for Purchase Street.
* Stay right off the exit onto Purchase Street
* Follow Purchase Street 2 blocks and turn left onto Congress Street.
* Take an immediate left onto Atlantic Avenue
* Follow Atlantic Avenue for 3 blocks and the Boston Harbor Hotel and the big arch will be on your right.
* A few feet from the big arch is the hotel parking entrance.
* Limited metered parking can be found around Rowes Wharf. Regular daily rate at the Boston Harbor Hotel is $42. However, with a validation from Classic Harbor Line it will be $36.  After 5PM weekdays and anytime on weekends the rate is $20, but with a validation it will be $14. Please be sure to ask our ticket representative for a validation when you check-in.

#Policies 
##Cancellation Policy
An option to reschedule or convert to a gift certificate is available up until 24-hours prior to departure. We are not able to offer refunds. Requests for cancellation, rescheduling, or conversion to gift credit must be sent by email to publicsails@boston-sailing.com. 

##Other Policies
**All participants are required to have tickets for this event.** 
According to U.S. Coast Guard capacity rules, all passengers **including infants and toddlers** must have a ticket.

**Activity may be canceled due to severe weather**
The activity usually runs in light rain and other moderate weather conditions, but the seller may cancel the activity up to an hour before the start time in the event of severe or unsafe weather conditions. If the seller cancels the event, ticket-holders will be allowed to reschedule tickets (subject to availability), receive a credit for a future event, or receive a refund.

**Beverages and Coolers**
Outside adult beverage and coolers are not allowed aboard. Please bring valid identification with you. Identification is checked prior to boarding for guests interested in an adult beverage. 

**Check-In**
Upon arrival to our location please check–in with our ticket representative inside the ferry terminal to receive boarding passes.

----------------------------------------------

#Private Charters
Both the Schooner Adirondack III and the Yacht Northern Lights are available for private charter!  Whether it be planning a special Birthday or Anniversary or suggesting a unique corporate outing, our yachts are perfect for every occasion.  

Click [here](https://boston-sailing.com/private-yacht-charters/) to view our private charter web page.
